## User Stories

### US-001 — Bootstrapping

As a Yoke user, I want a deterministic bootstrap path, so the full
flow can run end-to-end against this fixture.

#### Definition of Done

- [ ] Pre-flight passes against this fixture.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-001-1:** Pre-flight exits 0.

### US-002 — Discovery

As a Yoke user, I want discovery to surface the PRD shape, so the
spec generator has a stable input.

#### Definition of Done

- [ ] PRD parses into the canonical shape.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-002-1:** PRD shape conforms.

### US-003 — Tech-spec consumption

As a Yoke user, I want tech-spec to consume the approved PRD, so the
generator chain proceeds.

#### Definition of Done

- [ ] Spec parses into objective + contracts.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-003-1:** Spec parser exits 0.

### US-004 — Generate-sprints integration

As a Yoke user, I want generate-sprints to produce sprint bundles
from the (spec, AC) pair, so /yoke:implement consumes them
unchanged.

#### Definition of Done

- [ ] At least one sprint file produced.
- [ ] Every US realized at least once across the produced bundles.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-004-1:** Produced sprints cover every US.
- **AC-004-2:** Each sprint file conforms to templates/sprint.md.

## Functional Requirements

- **FR-1:** Full flow exits 0.
- **FR-2:** Produced sprint count matches expected-sprint-count.
